infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Sudoku Sally to access your camera to video-call your opponent during a challenge. If you and your opponent both choose to go live, this video may be streamed publicly to YouTube.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Sudoku Sally to access your microphone to talk to your opponent during a challenge. If you and your opponent both choose to go live, this audio may be streamed publicly to YouTube.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Sudoku Sally to access your camera to video-call your opponent. If both players go live, this video may be streamed publicly to YouTube.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Sudoku Sally to access your microphone to talk to your opponent. If both players go live, this audio may be streamed publicly to YouTube.
